title: Nell and the Pond
note: b415 — Phase 4 (Learning) — consonant clusters nd, nt, nk.

pages.brief: Nell the bee sitting on a reed low over a calm round pond.
A plain duck swimming on the surface of the pond below Nell.
A silver fish swimming just under the surface of the pond water.
The duck waddling up out of the pond onto the grassy bank.
The fish swimming deeper in the pond water, well away from the bank.
A wide view of the still pond in cool, shaded light.
Tall green pond plants growing still at the far end of the pond.
Small bugs landing on the green leaves of the pond plants.
Nell the bee hovering above the pond, looking down at a duck and a fish together.
